_comment: See WARRIOR.json for the format. replaceMods drops all generated links first.

Ignite.note: Proc chain: Fire crit → Ignite burn for a share of the hit. More crit (Critical Mass, Combustion) and bigger hits (Fire Power) mean bigger Ignites.

Master of Elements.note: Resource loop: every Fire or Frost crit refunds part of its mana cost, so crit doubles as mana regen.

Combustion.note: Burst: stacking Fire crit for three crits; each crit also feeds Ignite and Master of Elements.

Fire Power.note: Scales with how many of your Fire effects are on the target (Ignite, Living Bomb, Pyroblast's burn).

Arcane Concentration.note: Resource loop: any damage spell can make the next one free; spend Clearcasting on your most expensive spell.

Shatter.note: Combo: freeze (Frost Nova, Frostbite, Fingers of Frost) → Shatter crits.

mods.fx: chill can proc Fingers of Frost
hits as if the target were Frozen

Fingers of Frost.note: Proc chain: Chill → Fingers of Frost → next 2 spells count the target as Frozen → Shatter crits.

Frostbite.note: Proc chain: Chill → Freeze → Shatter crits.

Heating Up.note: Proc chain: Fire crits → faster Pyroblast casts (up to 3 stacks). More crit, more Pyroblasts.

Missile Barrage.note: Proc chain: Arcane Blast and your bolts → faster, cheaper Arcane Missiles.

Winter's Chill.note: Combo: Frostbolt or empowered Ice Lance → Winter's Chill → your next Cone of Cold hits harder.
